slot_m1_layer0_ambient_carrier.source_scope_review: The source declarations are l1_residual_sector_weights_minimizer_nonuniqueness_and_dihedral_selector (fixed rA=(1,1,0,0), rB=(0,0,1,1), plus a conjunct that is true for any w0,w1 and uses neither), even_cycle_sector_weights_require_selector (two fixed C4 vectors by decide), l1_even_cycle_symmetry_orbit_canonical_sector_weights (fixed vectors by decide; the orbit SUM has twice Phi1) and sector_weights_sum_to_phi1 (additivity of a list sum on append). None of them defines the minimum over a class, so "Phi1" there is the L1 of a given residual. The general claim is therefore proved afresh: on the n-cycle the class is the holonomy, Phi1 = |S|, the minimizers are a signed simplex, two minimizers with equal (Phi1, Gamma2) differ in sector weights, and the symmetric average is an extra declared selector (integral only when n divides S). Weighted L1 forms are not treated.
